composition_contract.DI_inner_counts: rt_inj_complete_profile already adds 2 psi draws and 1 encryption times the actual B invocation flag; never added again
composition_contract.measure_only: Core subtotals price measure; run_dispatchers independently price the actual run call/entry/return boundaries.
composition_contract.attacker_self: t_A upper-bounds only the instructions executed by A, excluding oracle bodies and all reduction frames.
composition_contract.primitive_model: finite word primitives plus ideal randomness/oracle events; no CPU-cycle/native storage or general PPT claim
composition_contract.conditional_fixed_work: Each reachable loopless helper is reserved once, even on rejecting branches; all variable-length work remains in the phase bucket.
composition_contract.actual_run: The actual security games call run. Its measured core is executed once and the independently priced dispatcher is added by RTCompleteCost.
